name: Invoice Capture: Gmail to Google Sheets

attributes.name: Absender
attributes.description: Der SHOP/Händler, bei dem gekauft wurde - NICHT der Zahlungsdienstleister. Steht in der Rechnung Klarna, PayPal oder Stripe als Absender, nenne trotzdem den Händler. Nur der Name, keine Adresse.

attributes.name: Rechnungsnummer
attributes.description: Rechnungs-, Bestell- oder Belegnummer aus dem PDF muss zwingend vorhanden sein. Wenn keine vorhanden, nicht aufnehmen.

attributes.name: Datum
attributes.description: Rechnungs- bzw. Kaufdatum im ISO-Format TT-MM-JJJJ (z.B. 12-09-2026). Kein anderes Format verwenden.

attributes.name: Betrag
attributes.description: Gezahlter Rechnungsbetrag als Zahl, Dezimalpunkt statt Komma (z.B. 59.08). Niemals schätzen -bei fehlender Währungsangabe, antworte mit 0.

attributes.name: Währung
attributes.description: 3-stelliger ISO-4217-Währungscode des Betrags, z.B. EUR, USD, THB, GBP. Aus Symbol oder Text ableiten (Euro/EUR->EUR, Dollar/$->USD, Baht/THB/Bahtzeichen->THB, Pfund/GBP->GBP). Wenn unklar, EUR verwenden.

attributes.name: istBeleg
attributes.description: true, wenn im Dokument eine KONKRETE Zahlungsverpflichtung mit Betrag und Währung steht - erkennbar an Wörtern wie 'Rechnung', 'Rechnungsnummer', 'Invoice', 'Invoice Number', 'Quittung', 'Kassenbon', 'Zahlungsbestätigung', 'Beleg'. Bei diesen Signalwörtern IMMER true, auch wenn sonst nichts Verdächtiges im Text steht. false NUR wenn das Dokument ausdrücklich als 'Angebot', 'Kostenvoranschlag', 'unverbindlich' oder 'freibleibend' gekennzeichnet ist, oder es sich um AGB, Widerrufsbelehrung, Katalog, Preisliste oder Werbung handelt - auch wenn dort ein Betrag genannt wird.

assignments.name: schluessel
assignments.value: ={{ ($('Combine PDF and Extraction').item.json.output.Absender || '').toLowerCase().split(/[\s,.-]+/)[0] + '-' + ($('Combine PDF and Extraction').item.json.output.Rechnungsnummer || $('Combine PDF and Extraction').item.json.id) }}

value.Datum: ={{ (() => { const ai = $('Combine PDF and Extraction').item.json.output.Datum; const gmailDate = $('Combine PDF and Extraction').item.json.date; let y, m, d; if (ai) { const p = ai.split('-'); if (p.length !== 3) return ''; d = Number(p[0]); m = Number(p[1]); y = Number(p[2]); } else if (gmailDate) { const iso = gmailDate.substring(0,10); const p = iso.split('-'); if (p.length !== 3) return ''; y = Number(p[0]); m = Number(p[1]); d = Number(p[2]); } else { return ''; } const utcMs = Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d); const epochMs = Date.UTC(1899, 11, 30); return Math.round((utcMs - epochMs) / 86400000); })() }}

parameters.url: ={{ (() => { const d = $json.output.Datum; if (!d) return 'https://api.frankfurter.dev/v1/latest'; const p = d.split('-'); if (p.length !== 3) return 'https://api.frankfurter.dev/v1/latest'; const iso = p[2] + '-' + p[1] + '-' + p[0]; return 'https://api.frankfurter.dev/v1/' + iso; })() }}

assignments.name: BetragEUR
assignments.value: ={{ $json.rates && $json.rates.EUR ? Math.round($('Combine PDF and Extraction').item.json.output.Betrag * $json.rates.EUR * 100) / 100 : $('Combine PDF and Extraction').item.json.output.Betrag }}

parameters.content:
# 📥 1. Fetch mails & ping

**Nodes:** Schedule Trigger, Get Invoice Mails, Healthcheck Ping

# What happens
## Every night the workflow looks for new mails with a PDF.

# Steps
## 1. Schedule Trigger starts the run at midnight
## 2. Get Invoice Mails takes the 10 newest mails that have a PDF and no label "Geprüft"
## 3. Healthcheck Ping tells healthchecks.io that the run has started

# Good to know
### The ping is sent even when there are no new mails. If it is missing, healthchecks.io sends an alert.
### If Gmail fails, the node tries 3 times with 5 seconds in between.
### More than 10 new mails? The rest follows the next night.

# 🤖 2. Read the PDF & AI

**Nodes:** Find Invoice PDFs, Extract from File, Build Prompt Text, Parse Invoice Data, OpenAI Chat Model, Combine PDF and Extraction

# What happens
## We pick the right PDF, read its text and let AI pull out the invoice data.

# Steps
## 1. Find Invoice PDFs picks the best PDF of each mail
## 2. Extract from File reads the text of the PDF
## 3. Build Prompt Text puts subject, mail sender and PDF text into one block
## 4. Parse Invoice Data asks the AI (OpenAI Chat Model, gpt-5-mini) for seller, number, date, amount, currency and "is it an invoice?"
## 5. Combine PDF and Extraction joins the PDF and the answer again

# Why the mail sender is marked
### The mail sender is not always the seller. Build Prompt Text says so, so the AI takes the seller from the PDF.

# Good to know
### A PDF without text (a scan) gives the AI only subject and sender. The result is then usually "not an invoice".
### Find Invoice PDFs prefers file names with words like "Rechnung" or "invoice" and skips words like "AGB".

# ❓ 3. Is it an invoice?

**Nodes:** Is Invoice?, Label as Invoice

# What happens
## We only keep real invoices. Offers, ads and terms are ignored.

# Steps
## 1. Is Invoice? checks two things: the AI says "invoice" and the amount is above 0
## 2. Yes: Label as Invoice adds the Gmail label "Rechnung", and the run goes on to box 4
## 3. No: nothing is saved. The mail only gets "Geprüft" in box 6

# Good to know
### Words like "Rechnung" or "Invoice Number" are a clear sign for the AI. Offers, price lists and terms are not invoices, even when they show an amount.

# 💱 4. Convert the currency

**Nodes:** Is EUR?, Mark as EUR, Get Exchange Rate, Apply FX Conversion

# What happens
## Every amount ends up in euro.

# Steps
## 1. Is EUR? checks the currency
## 2. EUR: Mark as EUR keeps the amount
## 3. Other currency: Get Exchange Rate asks the ECB rate for the invoice date (frankfurter.dev)
## 4. Apply FX Conversion calculates the euro amount

# Good to know
### The rate comes from the invoice date, not from today.
### Some currencies have no rate (for example AED). Then the original amount and currency stay, and the run does not stop.

# 📝 5. Save the row & the PDF

**Nodes:** Set Key, Remove Duplicates, Save to Sheet, Has PDF?, Reattach PDF Binary, Upload to Drive

# What happens
## One row goes into the sheet and the PDF goes into Google Drive.

# Steps
## 1. Set Key builds a key: first word of the seller + invoice number (e.g. "example-RE-2001"). No number: the mail ID is used
## 2. Remove Duplicates drops items with the same key inside one run
## 3. Save to Sheet writes the row. The same key updates the old row, so there are no double rows
## 4. Has PDF? checks if there is a file to store
## 5. Reattach PDF Binary puts the original PDF back
## 6. Upload to Drive saves the PDF in the invoice folder

# Why Reattach PDF Binary?
### Save to Sheet returns only the row, the file is gone after it. Reattach PDF Binary takes the PDF again from Find Invoice PDFs.

# Good to know
### No date on the invoice: the mail date is used.
### Save to Sheet and Upload to Drive try 3 times if they fail.

# ✅ 6. Mark & reliability

**Nodes:** Mark as Checked

# What happens
## Every processed mail gets a stamp, so it is not read again.

# Steps
## 1. Mark as Checked adds the label "Geprüft" to the mail (invoice or not)
## 2. If the label fails 3 times, the run stops
## 3. The error workflow sends a Telegram alert: workflow, node, error text and a link

# Reliability
### Retries: Gmail, Sheets and Drive 3 times, OpenAI 2 times.
### Healthchecks.io checks that the run starts every night (box 1).
### No alert on purpose: an unknown currency and a PDF without text.

# Good to know
### After a stop, mails without "Geprüft" are tried again the next night. The key (box 5) prevents double rows.

# 📋 Invoice Capture: Gmail to Google Sheets

# What problem it solves
## Invoices arrive by mail as PDFs, often in other currencies. Someone has to open each one, type the data into a sheet and save the file.
## That is slow and boring, and it is easy to make mistakes or to type the same invoice twice. Missed invoices mean late fees and messy books.
## This workflow does it every night. It reads the PDFs, converts the money into euro, writes one row per invoice and stores the PDF.

# The 6 boxes
## 1. Fetch mails & ping
## 2. Read the PDF & AI
## 3. Is it an invoice?
## 4. Convert the currency
## 5. Save the row & the PDF
## 6. Mark & reliability

# What happens to a mail
## - Invoice: one row in the sheet, the PDF in Drive, labels "Rechnung" and "Geprüft"
## - Other currency: converted to euro with the ECB rate of the invoice date
## - Known invoice: the old row is updated, no double row (box 5)
## - Not an invoice (offer, ad, terms): only "Geprüft"
## - No PDF text (scan): usually seen as "not an invoice"

# Tools
### Gmail, OpenAI (gpt-5-mini), Frankfurter API (ECB rates), Google Sheets, Google Drive, Telegram, Healthchecks.io

# Language
### Node names and notes are English. The sheet columns, the Gmail labels and the AI prompt are German on purpose, because the invoices and the accounts are German.
